caption: A click 30° right, with ear spacing 0.175 m, has an extra path of 0.0875 m. The right ear receives it first; the left ear is delayed by 0.255 ms, or 11 samples at 44.1 kHz.

spec.title: Worked example: click 30° right
spec.aria: A click 30 degrees to the right with ear spacing 0.175 metres gives an extra path of 0.0875 metres and reaches the right ear first, while the left ear is delayed by 0.255 milliseconds or 11 samples at 44.1 kilohertz; headphones replay both ear signals and the listener perceives the direction.
